why: The specs were written with the socket tools on the right arm. Power Armor swapped the arms (2026-10-13) by mirroring the whole model, so bb.mjs mirrors the model back for the specs and mirrors their output onto the live rig.
ankle_why: The boot's ankle cuff (model/art/legs_stomper_art.py) has room for the shin from 30 deg toes-down to 40 deg toes-up; past that plant() rolls the boot (k2.js).
